2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/37, continuation of the fin/1-36 rollout). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #37): "(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)\nI — Aerial Blast — This creature deals 4 damage to target tapped creature an opponent controls.\nII, III — Slipstream — Another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.\nFlying". {3}{W}, Enchantment Creature — Saga Harpy, 3/3 — all verified unchanged against fin_scryfall.json (mana cost/type line/P-T all already correct in definition.ts).

Flying (self, printed) stays a bare keyword, no fact, per the standing rule.

Real engine fix, definition.ts: Slipstream's 'gets +1/+0 and gains flying' used to be one `custom` effect with a manual pool filter and an explicit 'flying grant not mechanically enforced' comment — STALE as of today's concurrent batch (Moogles' Valor/Restoration Magic both closed the real keyword-grant gap earlier today). Replaced with two real, distinct Effect kinds — `{kind:'pumpTarget', power:1, toughness:0, owner:'you', notSelf:true}` + `{kind:'grantKeywordTarget', keyword:'Flying', owner:'you', notSelf:true}` — same split Gladiolus Amicitia's own 'another target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample' already established (no Effect kind grants P/T-plus-keyword in one shot). Both are real, state-mutating, not documentary. Chapter I's own 'target tapped creature' half: confirmed `Card.isTapped()` genuinely exists (interfaces.ts/state.ts) — this file's own prior comment claiming it didn't was simply wrong — but left deliberately UNWIRED: `Constraints.tapped` (synergy.ts) is itself purely documentary, not consulted by the fact matcher, same treatment Fate of the Sun-Cryst's identical-shaped cost condition already gets, so wiring a real tapped-only pool filter would only cost this card's own scenario its one legal target (the plain harness's generic `creaturesCount` filler starts untapped, with no seeding option for a pre-tapped creature) for zero real matching benefit. Documented inline in definition.ts.

Facts (7 source, 2 sink), all annotations baked via compute-annotations.mjs off a new annotations-authoring.json, `value` resolved for real via compute-weights.mjs --slug (not left at -1): self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'} (typeLine-anchored 'Creature') and self-enters {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', target:'self'} (typeLine-anchored 'Enchantment Creature') mirror Summon: Bahamut's own pair exactly. Chapter I damage: {event:'damage', controller:'you', recipient:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}, tapped:true}, targeted:true} — reuses the NEW `Constraints.tapped` field fate-of-the-sun-cryst added earlier today (its own real 'targets a tapped creature' sink condition) — this is the SECOND real use, confirming it's genuinely reusable, not a one-off; both uses are equally documentary/unenforced by the matcher, which is consistent, not a regression. Real magnitude: value resolved to 5 (steep bucket for a real trace magnitude of 4, `compute-weights.mjs`'s own damage case reads the real `fn:'dealDamage' amount:4` line) — the `--slug=` scoped flag made this safe to resolve for real without touching the rest of the pool. Chapters II/III Slipstream: TWO distinct facts for the two distinct real mechanisms, not merged — {event:'pump', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} (+1/+0) and {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:'Flying', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} (temporary flying) — same 'don't merge distinct mechanisms' discipline flagged to Summon: Knights of Round's own migration this same batch. Neither carries a self-exclusion marker for 'another' — checked Ambrosia Whiteheart's own real 'another permanent you control' bounce fact (migrated) and Summon: Knights of Round's own real 'other creatures you control' pump/counter facts (migrated same batch): neither represents self-exclusion in the Fact model at all — it's purely an ENGINE-side `notSelf` concern (Effect-level), no Constraints vocabulary exists (or is needed) for it. 'Sacrifice after III' represented the same way Summon: Bahamut's own 'Sacrifice after IV' is: a bare ACT `{event:'sacrifice', target:'self'}` plus a separate merged CONSEQUENCE `{event:'dies', from:'Battlefield', to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self', target:'self'}`. Dropped a `{event:'putCounter', counterType:'LORE', target:'self'}` lore-counter fact I initially authored (mirroring Summon: Bahamut's own pilot-scenario precedent) after verify-synergy.mjs caught it as a real hard failure with no possible trace evidence under THIS card's own scenario style (see below) — checked summon-choco-mog's own real synergy.json (same batch, same scenario style, migrated today): it has no lore-counter fact either, for the identical structural reason, confirming this is the correct, established treatment for this scenario shape rather than a gap unique to this card.

Sink facts (2, reshaped from the old v1 `zone`->`to`, `id`/`sourceText`/`highlight` dropped): aerial-blast-target {to:'Battlefield', controller:'opp', types:{has:['Creature']}, tapped:true} (the same documentary `tapped` treatment as the source-side damage fact — a consumer wanting 'a tapped creature an opponent controls' as bait) and slipstream-target {to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}}.

Scenarios.ts: consolidated to ONE real, continuous scenario (standing rule: 'default to one scenario'), mirroring summon-choco-mog's own real `sequence`+`sacrificeSelfAfter` shape (same batch, same day) rather than the heavier engine-trace pilot style Summon: Bahamut/Fate of the Sun-Cryst use — chosen specifically because `sacrificeSelfAfter` (harness.ts) is the literal, correct mechanism for 'Sacrifice after III' under this scenario style, and the plain harness's own generic `creaturesCount` filler has no way to seed a pre-tapped creature anyway (see the `Constraints.tapped` reasoning above for why that's not a real loss). `sequence: ['chapterI','chapterII','chapterIII']`, `you: {creaturesCount: 2}` (a real second creature besides Garuda so Slipstream's own notSelf exclusion is genuinely exercised, not vacuous), `opponents: [{creaturesCount: 1}]`. Real trace: `fn:'dealDamage' amount:4` (chapter I), `fn:'pump' power:1 toughness:0` + `fn:'grantKeyword' keyword:'Flying'` fired TWICE against the SAME real filler creature (chapters II/III, confirming `chooseTarget`'s deterministic pool ordering lands both real effects on one target), `fn:'sacrifice'` after chapter III. verify-synergy.mjs (scoped): 0 hard failures, all 9 facts real-annotated.
